implementationNotes: Use these assets within a clearly labeled Radio History section, not the current GTA VI station list.
Use the Lazlow Vice City artwork as the main wide nostalgia image; station logos can accompany timeline cards.
Chatterbox, V-Rock and LCFR are vector assets and stay crisp at larger sizes. Integrity is500×236 and oldFlash is334×205; keep these modestly sized.
Flash image originates from the Vice City Stories website, so the manifest explicitly includes both related games.
Include the exact GTA Wiki file-page links in credits as requested by the archive. Do not imply these logos announce the return of any GTA VI station.
